ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy sha=49a7631b1ddb ("Profiling with firepit", 2026-05-16T12:04:07Z) inadvertently doubled the HTTP client timeout default from 30000ms to 60000ms in payment-service/internal/httpclient/config.go and payment-service/config/defaults.yaml. Because stripe-gateway responses normally complete in ~200ms but the payment-service timeout is now 60s, transient stripe slowdowns (5-6s responses) no longer fail fast — instead each attempt runs to the full per-attempt timeout threshold (mis-set at 6000ms rather than 3000ms), causing 3 retries × ~6s = ~18s of wall time per request. The high per-request retry cost rapidly exhausted the fixed retry budget (100 tokens/minute), causing all subsequent charge requests to be rejected with 503 within 2 minutes of deploy.
ground_truth_remediation: Roll back payment-service to the previous known-good deploy sha=30ba52fd9566 immediately using the standard rollback pipeline (`kubectl set image deployment/payment-service payment-service=payment-service:30ba52fd9566` or equivalent). Confirm http_client_timeout_ms returns to 30000ms in startup logs and that retry_budget consumption returns to near-zero. Once recovered, create a follow-up PR to revert the timeout change in config/defaults.yaml and internal/httpclient/config.go, add a config validation test asserting timeout_ms <= 35000, and redeploy 49a7631b1ddb with the fix.
